problems.memo_sentence: It claims to identify optimization as the most commercially promising near-term application class and concludes, with a cautiously optimistic stance, that there is already strong potential for quantum technologies to transform the financial industry despite the absence of current practical advantage.

The memo condenses this into a more assertive statement of "strong potential" to transform the industry, losing some of the paper’s conditional and speculative tone.
